zh.text: 某小型開放經濟一直對進口紅酒實施有效配額。若紅酒的國際價格下降，____。

en.text: the volume of red wine imported by the economy will increase

zh.text: 該經濟的紅酒進口量會上升

en.text: the quantity of red wine domestically produced in the economy will increase

zh.text: 該經濟的本地紅酒生產量會上升

en.text: the quantity of red wine consumed in the economy will remain unchanged

zh.text: 該經濟的紅酒消費量會維持不變

en.text: the price of red wine sold in the economy will decrease

zh.text: 該經濟中銷售的紅酒的價格會下降

en.text: A small open economy has imposed an effective import quota on wheat. If the domestic production cost of wheat decreases, _____.

zh.text: 某小型開放經濟對小麥實施一項有效進口配額。若小麥的本地生產成本下降，______。

en.text: (1) and (3) only
(1) and (4) only
(2) and (3) only
(2) and (4) only
the quantity of wheat produced domestically will increase

zh.text: 小麥的本地生產量會上升

en.text: the import quantity of wheat will increase

zh.text: 小麥的進口量會上升

en.text: the domestic price of wheat will decrease

zh.text: 小麥的本地價格會下降

en.text: the world price of wheat will decrease

zh.text: 小麥的世界價格會下降
